nodes.text: Dr Lancelot Pinto, a pulmonologist at PD Hinduja Hospital, said, "It is not uncommon to detect cases of HMPV in India. We only test when someone is adversely impacted, as the test panel can be expensive, costing Rs 15,000 to Rs 20,000." https://t.co/gzlL5ZJiJq
